Pauses every channel on a bus and on the buses that feed it. This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
PauseAudioBus world
```
@param bus  A bus from [CreateAudioBus](CreateAudioBus), or `0` for the master bus. Anything else is a runtime error.
@gap The channels are still there, [ChannelPlaying](ChannelPlaying) gives 1 for them, and a channel that starts on a paused bus starts paused. [ResumeAudioBus](ResumeAudioBus) plays them on.
